You use linking words to help you organize what you have written in a text.  It also helps you introduce and develop essential ideas.
Linking words help you to connect ideas and sentences, so that people can follow your ideas.

Here are some examples:
  • On the other hand
  • In fact
  • Of course
  • In addition
  • Indeed
Another key application of robots in medicine is in the pharmaceutical industry.
In fact, automated robots can fill a prescription in 10 seconds, and are extremely accurate.
In addition, the kinds of errors involved in reading handwriting must have been reduced by automation.
Indeed, robots could  play an important role in many areas of society.

You can use modals to talk about degrees of certainty.

You use them to describe what is definite, probable, possible, or impossible from the speaker's point of view.
You can use must, may, might, and could to describe degrees of certainty.

Must = it's very likely
Must not / Could not / Can't = it's not possible
May / Might / Can / Could = it's possible
May not / Might not = it's possible this is not true

images.text: Although robots used to be the domain of science fiction novels and movies, they are now increasingly being used in mainstream society. Tasks that were previously reserved  for humans, can now be performed by intelligent robots. The healthcare field is one of the major areas of interest for robotics experts.

Robots have an advantage in performing surgery because they are extremely precise, and, often, make fewer mistakes than a human surgeon. In addition, they can reach areas that a surgeon would not be able to get to easily, and they have three-dimensional magnification. They have been employed in cardiac surgery, gastrointestinal surgery, gynecological procedures, and neurosurgery. The use of robots to assist the elderly may be one way of providing physical and emotional care to these patients. Besides needing physical help, aged patients often become lonely and withdrawn. Because many elderly people might be unable to care for a pet or live in a home that does not allow pets, some scientists are asking if a robotic pet could provide the same benefits.

Another key application of robots in medicine is in the pharmaceutical industry. In fact, automated robots can fill a prescription in 10 seconds, and are extremely accurate. In addition, the kinds of errors involved in reading handwriting must have been reduced by automation. Indeed, robots could  play an important role in many areas of society. In the medical industry, the advent of these intelligent machines will continue to improve the quality of people's lives.
